text:
marco: Quick flag 1 PRs with SDK snippets are blocking the docs release train. We only have one reviewer on deck and it's lunchtime. Anyone available to pick one up? :coffee:

zoe: Drop the numbers? I can spare 30-45 after standup.

marco: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/510 (python snippet failing tests), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/511 (link anchor fix), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/513 (migration guide additions)

tara: I can take 511 (anchor fix) and 513 (migration) but 510 needs running the snippet harness locally. Ben, you on snippet duty today?

ben: I'm on infra pager until 2pm. If someone else can run the harness, I can review after 3pm. The harness command is `make snippet-check && ./tools/run-snippets --ci` in repo root.

zoe: I can run the harness for 510 now. heads-up it fails if Docker image cache missing.

docs-bot: CI preview for PR 510 created: https://deploy-preview-510--docs.redwood.ai (status: failed due to missing wheel).

marco: thanks zoe. two process Qs: 1) can we add a short 'snippet-tested: yes' checklist line in PRs so reviewers don't repeat work? 2) who is allowed to squash vs merge? our release notes prefer squash to keep history tidy.
